turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on the present continuous (am/is/are + -ing)?
turns.tutor:
Sure! Look: Mia is eating a sandwich.

Use am, is or are plus a verb with -ing to say what happens at this moment.

Right: "My friend is playing a game on his phone." Wrong: "My friend playing a game on his phone."

Your turn. Write your sentences:
Imagine a park. Write two sentences about what people are doing now.
